# The 90s Club

The 90s Club is a Kerala kitchen and retro taproom on the top floor of Millennium Plaza, Hebbagodi, Electronic City, Bangalore. Fully enclosed and air-conditioned, about 80 seats. The taproom serves Flying Fox craft beer.

Address: Millennium Plaza, 396/48 Hosur Rd, Dadi Reddy Layout, Veerasandra, Hebbagodi, Electronic City, Bangalore 560100
Phone: +91 96321 41188
WhatsApp: +91 96321 41188
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/the90sclubretropub
Hours: 12 PM to 12 AM every day; event nights till 1 AM
Parking: at Millennium Plaza
Seats: about 80, full AC, indoor
Geo: 12.8346301, 77.6793577
Google Maps: https://share.google/IelhjSarfxq2uls3r
Founders: Akhil Kumar and Sathish
Opened: February 2026
